import parse
# Test various integer formats
tests = [
    ('{:x}', '0xFF'),
    ('{:#x}', '0xFF'),
    ('{:#b}', '0b1010'),
    ('{:o}', '0o77'),
]
for fmt, val in tests:
    r = parse.parse(fmt, val)
    print(f'{fmt!r} + {val!r} -> {r}')
" 2>/dev/null
